ehiExport.description: The EHI export contains the electronic health information available for a single patient or multiple patients in computable file formats. The export(s) can be downloaded as a zip file containing a .json and a .xml file.

json.description: FHIR bundle with all resources on record belonging to the patient

xml.description: Patient Continuity of Care Document formatted in accordance with the C-CDA version 2.1 specification

requestParameters.description: Format yyyy-mm-dd, when provided, all of the data associated with the patient created after this date should be included

extensions.name: Machine learning
extensions.description: One Medical uses machine learning (ML) technology to automatically process certain health data and make predictions that can be verified by our healthcare professionals. Records that were generated automatically by our ML models are marked with several extensions to provide information about how the record was generated. Note that resources with these extensions should generally NOT be considered authoritative, and they are often marked explicitly with preliminary or draft status.Resources deriv

terminology.description: This is a "Terms of Service" consent form. These are generally signed by new members when they first join One Medical.
Treat Me Now – identifies secure message threads that began as a result of the member using our Treat Me Now service.
After Visit Summary – these are created following an encounter and provides follow-up instructions to the member.
